developpement.title: Your web or mobile application in <u>15 days</u>.
developpement.subtitle: We reduce your project together to its first essential functional brick. Designed, developed and delivered in 2 weeks.
whyPoints: We firmly believe in "less is more". Reducing your project to its essentials is a very instructive exercise. Don't worry, we have the methods to help you.
Delays are missed opportunities. Projects that ship are always better than the others.
There's a reason why 2 weeks is the standard duration of a sprint in Agile methodology: no tunnel effect. We deliver concrete results quickly to test your app quickly!

Everything is faster today thanks to the alliance of human expertise and artificial intelligence. In 2 weeks we guarantee we can code and deliver the 1st essential and functional brick of your project.
guarantees: Guaranteed budget: €5000 excl. VAT — no overruns
Guaranteed deadline: 2 weeks of development — no overruns (full refund)
Delivery of clean code that you own: optimized, robust code that meets standards, ready to be taken over by any competent developer, and ready to serve as the basis for your application's evolution.
developpement.bridge: Need to clarify your idea or priorities?

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: We start with a simple 15-minute call to get to know each other and see if your project qualifies for such a 2-week brick breakdown

steps.title: Scoping meeting
steps.description: If yes, we schedule a 1-hour meeting during which we define this 1st brick in detail

steps.title: Specifications
steps.description: We write detailed technical specifications and have you validate them

steps.title: Contract
steps.description: Contractualization and online payment of 50% of the amount

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We create the design of your application and have you validate it (1-2 days in general)

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: Delivery on our test server or directly on your server (we also guide you on that if needed)!

steps.title: Final payment
steps.description: Payment of the remaining 50% upon going live!

process.afterDescription: You continue with us (we hope) or without us for the following bricks, the code is yours!

conseil.title: Clarify, prioritize, concretize
conseil.longIntro:
The best decisions come from a clear and shared vision.
I help teams and project leaders get out of the fog, prioritize what matters and transform their challenges into concrete solutions — whether it's a product, a service or an AI project.
conseil.intro: Dual engineering degree in AI (well before the chatGPT hype) and Aerospace (the rigor of embedded systems), as well as 20 years of experience in software, web and mobile projects.

ateliers.title: Workshop "MVP Sprint" — Clarify your challenges and give shape to your ideas
ateliers.intro: You have an idea, ideas, you don't know where to start, what's relevant, what's complicated, what's essential, what's technically possible with the latest AI technologies or not. The goal of this workshop is to eliminate the superfluous and give you a clarified vision.
deroulement: Half a day (3 hours) of exploration and ideation, questioning and constructive criticism, then organization and clarification of ideas
Half a day (3 hours) of listing and prioritizing features, then designing your MVP
livrables: A workshop report with the functional and technical choices made
A data schema and graphic mockups of the application
A development estimate broken down into 2-week bricks

ateliers.title: Workshop "AI Express" — Transform a problem into an AI solution
ateliers.intro: We take one of your particular problems and confront it with innovative but proven AI solutions, to see what can adapt to your business context. We aim here as everywhere for an intelligent and relevant integration of AI, to give you a real advantage.
deroulement: Detailed definition of the problem or challenge ("a well-posed problem is half solved"): existing, objective, actors, inputs/outputs, constraints
Search for potentially suitable solutions and pre-selection
Verdict (choice or not, of a candidate technology)
livrables: A workshop report including a summary of the problem, objectives and sketch of the identified AI solution
ateliers.option: Development of a POC (Proof of Concept) of the solution, delivered in 48h. €890 excl. VAT

ateliers.title: Consulting Mission — Integrate AI as a Decisive Advantage
ateliers.tagline: Integrate Artificial Intelligence as a decisive advantage in your business
ateliers.intro: Every day new announcements, new tools, new methods... Are you lost? Don't panic. We start from your real needs, and see if AI can be relevant for you, and how. A first 30-minute meeting will already give us a good idea of potential leads.
ateliers.firstCall: A first 30-minute meeting will already give us a good idea of potential leads, and whether it's worth continuing. If so, you'll be in good hands!
method: Audit your business processes, decision systems, and data flows
Analyze possible optimizations using the most suitable AI technologies taking into account your specific constraints (cloud/local, confidentiality, human in the loop, etc.)

Choose from 3 optimization scenarios proposed by our consultant:
  • Maximum impact with minimum process changes
  • Maximum cost reduction
  • Complete overhaul of the information system around AI agents

consultant.title: Consultant
consultant.name: David Lascombe
consultant.intro: In twenty years of digital projects, I've often seen the same thing: promising but fuzzy ideas, or ambitious projects that struggle to find their framework. My role, whether it's application development or consulting, is to bring clarity — understand real needs, connect strategy to concrete solutions and help turn an idea into a feasible project.
consultant.clientsText: CNRS, Suez, Red Bull, La Banque Postale, CDiscount, Dekra, Cultura, and dozens of startups, SMEs, midcaps and project leaders in France, Canada and elsewhere...
diplomas: Dual engineering degree in AI (well before the chatGPT hype) and Aerospace (the rigor of embedded systems)
20 years of experience in software, web and mobile projects
expertise: Supporting project leaders on UX, tech and business topics: startups, SMEs, and large groups for nearly 15 years
Company leader and innovator for over 10 years
